info.name: ClearCall media-processing-service API
info.description:
ClearCall media-processing-service API, generated from docs/openapi.json.

1. Set the collection variable `bearerToken` to a Cognito access or ID token (without the 'Bearer ' prefix).
2. Set `baseUrl` if the service is not on http://localhost:8080.
3. Set `assetId`, `userId` and `advisorId` to real ids to call the endpoints that take them.

Workflow rules, ownership and dashboard definitions: docs/API.md.
